timestamp_derivation: Read from the workstation clock (UTC+02:00) by the script that wrote this receipt, immediately before the commit that introduces it.
authorisation: The Product Owner's mission of 2026-11-06 (D99): complete Automatic Reconnection end to end with deployment to the test appliance 172.21.96.97 only.
delivery: PR #386 (merged c0176a9c): netd /v1/address/owner falls back to Kea's live lease table when the enforcement pass's lease list does not show the address owned; portald logs why it stopped before asking scd (mac_unresolved, scd_unreachable); scd's rejoin answers carry the device address; monitor README explains how to read a waiting device.
findings: Of the devices the monitor reported as waiting (4 to 7), every one held a lease taken before the fix and sent nothing the appliance could act on: scd's own candidate query found each eligible, no probe from their addresses was redirected all day, a 15-minute capture by hardware address saw zero frames, and their neighbour entries were STALE (phones asleep or out of range with an 8 h lease). Verified defect: during an enforcement pass the ownership query read the lease list fetched when the pass began; a device that probed right after joining was refused (live: lease at 16:10:41.274, refusal address_not_owned unknown at .420 inside a 438 ms pass) and portald's 15 s quiet window dropped the rest of its probe burst; 6 eligible devices earlier that day had probed at join, been turned away and reconnected 1 to 30 min later. Explained non-defect: a device whose last session ran on a client network since replaced (11-04) is declined by the approved same-network rule. Observation: an appliance-internal check from the gateway address reaches the portal page 3 times a minute and is logged as mac_unresolved; it does not affect guests.
verification: netd owner-query test during a pass (fresh lease owned, reassigned foreign) with -race; portald rejoin tests; vet; Codex review clean. Live, 40 min before the fix: 16 eligible devices joined, 11 reconnected within 10 min, 3 silent, 2 probe-and-refused (one same-network refusal); 40 min after: 3 joined, 1 reconnected, 1 silent, 1 the same-network case; 0 address_not_owned refusals after the fix against 1 before; no eligible device that probed was turned away. Through the day: 119 reconnections without user interaction, median 9 s from DHCP to online. NOT VERIFIED: the fix under a full day's load (the window after it had few joins).
